summary: Locked curl at its current version (8.9.1-5.el10) on node1 using dnf versionlock (installed the plugin, added the lock), verified it excludes curl from a simulated system update, then completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured boot_id baseline, issued an async systemctl reboot, polled through the outage, confirmed a changed boot_id post-restart, and re-verified curl's version and the versionlock rule persisted and still exclude curl from updates.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS (RHEL 10.0) and current curl package version (curl-8.9.1-5.el10.x86_64)
Falsified the lock by running dnf update --assumeno and confirming curl was absent from the transaction (grep exit 1)
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, uptime, curl version, versionlock list, systemctl is-system-running
Issued systemctl reboot asynchronously on node1 so the ack returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Verified boot_id changed (73237116-... -> f5f31edc-...) and uptime showed 0 min, proving an actual restart
Re-verified post-restart: curl version unchanged, versionlock rule still present, curl still excluded from a simulated update, system fully running

evidence.requirement: Baseline: curl current version and system health before any changes
evidence.summary: rpm -q curl showed curl-8.9.1-5.el10.x86_64 as the installed version; dnf 4.20.0 confirmed as package manager

evidence.requirement: versionlock plugin installed to enable pinning
evidence.summary: Confirmed versionlock subcommand missing, then installed dnf-command(versionlock) plugin successfully

evidence.requirement: curl locked to its current version
evidence.summary: dnf versionlock add curl added lock curl-0:8.9.1-5.el10.*, confirmed present in versionlock list

evidence.requirement: Falsification: prove the lock actually excludes curl from updates
evidence.summary: Simulated dnf update --assumeno listed 263 packages to upgrade but curl was not among them; explicit grep for curl in the transaction returned exit code 1 (not found)

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart baseline: boot identity and service/data health
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 73237116-86a8-4aee-9e04-b090deb536f8, curl version, versionlock list, and systemctl is-system-running=running before restart
Backgrounded systemctl reboot returned reboot_issued_pid immediately, ack received before node went down

evidence.requirement: Node restart evidence: connection loss then recovery, changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Two polls timed out/reset (node down during reboot), then a poll succeeded showing boot_id f5f31edc-2d66-4de8-a6a4-a48aae0dcae0 (different from baseline) and uptime 'up 0 min', proving a real restart occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery: curl version and versionlock persisted, task requirement still enforced
evidence.summary: After restart, rpm -q curl still shows curl-8.9.1-5.el10.x86_64, versionlock list still shows curl-0:8.9.1-5.el10.*, simulated update again excludes curl (grep_exit:1), and systemctl is-system-running=running
